body:
Connect nested sheet layouts to `WaterjetProfile`, `PlasmaProfile`, and `Contour` toolpath generation and run full-sheet 2D cut-order, router-corner, and kerf verification at the post gate.

Depends on #2159, #2160, #1883, and #1885.

## Scope

- **Nested sheet geometry resolution (`crates/app/src/operation/`):**
  - Resolve placed part instances of a nested sheet into world-space loops and open chains with their resolved cut sides (`Outside`, `OnLine`, `Inside`, `Left`, `Right`) and global cut order from `#2159` and `#2160`.
  - Keep operations synchronized with `NestDef` via `current_stamp` so layout edits mark sheet operations stale cleanly.
- **Machine-neutral toolpath generation (`crates/motion/`, `crates/app/`):**
  - Wire sheet operations for `WaterjetProfile` (`#1883`), `PlasmaProfile`, and `Contour` (`Kind::Mill` sheet routers).
  - On `Kind::Mill` router nests, use `tool.diameter` as the cut width, enforce `part_gap >= tool.diameter` (refuse smaller gaps by name), support holding strategies (`tab_count`/`tab_width`/`tab_height`, onion-skin floor allowance + final skin-break pass, vacuum small-before-large order), and emit inside-corner cutter-radius warnings when concave corners are tighter than `tool.diameter / 2`.
  - Pass the union of all placed parts and cut footprints on the sheet as `forbidden` regions when placing pierce points and leads (`crates/motion/src/plasma/emit.rs` and `#1883`).
  - Refuse by name when a lead cannot fit clear of neighboring parts, or when a contour requests an unsupported open-path compensation side.
  - Keep clean hooks for marking-first and common-line sequencing (`#1447`) and future laser operations (`#2022`).
- **Full-sheet 2D verification (`crates/sim/src/verify/plasma/`, `#1885`, `crates/app/src/posting_plasma.rs`):**
  - Verify the combined sheet cut sequence as one program (`CutOrder`, `CutCrossing`, `KerfCrossing`, `TipUp`, and machine XY bed bounds).
  - Block posting at the gate if a part inside a hole cuts after the hole, or if any cut crosses another part or kerf beyond rules.

## Done means

A multi-part nest with holes, open cuts, and a small part nested inside a hole generates golden CL and posts G-code per sheet for waterjet, plasma, and router setups (including tabs and onion-skin passes); router inside-corner radius limits report accurately; pierce points and leads stay clear of neighboring parts; full-sheet verification blocks out-of-order or crossing cuts at the post gate.

Part of #2156
